name: contact
description: Select contacts. active Select only active contacts. The activity status depends on the contact model installed at the contacts.

sub_keywords.name: all
sub_keywords.description: Select all contacts (active and inactive). This is the default behavior. The activity status depends on the contact model installed at the contacts.

sub_keywords.name: gap
sub_keywords.description: Select contacts based on their gap (see Contact Resolution). If only one value f1 is specified, then only contacts with a gap \(g \leq f_1\) are selected. If a second value f2 is input, than all contacts with a gap in the range \(f_1 \leq g \leq f_2\) are selected.

sub_keywords.name: inactive
sub_keywords.description: Select only inactive contacts. The activity status depends on the contact model installed at the contacts.

sub_keywords.name: model
sub_keywords.description: Select contacts based on their contact model name.

sub_keywords.name: type
sub_keywords.description: Select contacts based on their contact type (see this Figure).
